title: B1 strict HTTP/1.1 chunked CRLF framing validation and loopback wire tests in susi-conformance/src/http.rs
goal: Enforce RFC 9112 trailing CRLF chunk-terminator validation in HTTP/1.1 chunked decoding (originally crates/susi-conformance/src/http.rs in 97c16e2c9 #1395, now crates/susi-wire-client/src/http.rs re-exported as susi_conformance::http via a1ee7860d) and add unit tests covering malformed chunk framing, status/header edge cases, and loopback HTTP/1.1 POST + chunked response decoding (B1).

reuse.reason: Hardened existing HTTP/1.1 chunked framing and response parser originally in crates/susi-conformance/src/http.rs (landed in squash commit 97c16e2c95f73b7c1257dfde175092f49661665b #1395; subsequently extracted to crates/susi-wire-client/src/http.rs in a1ee7860d and re-exported by susi-conformance) without introducing external HTTP crates.
